candidate_actions.violated_requirement: When in state s6, if data is 1, the next state should transition to sf1 to properly handle non-matching sequences. Changing to s1 would incorrectly treat it as a potential start of a new matching sequence.
candidate_actions.spec_basis: The specification requires proper handling of non-matching sequences by transitioning to failure states (sf1-sf6) when the sequence doesn't match.

candidate_actions.violated_requirement: When in state s6, if data is 1, transitioning to sf6 instead of sf1 would incorrectly maintain the final failure state rather than resetting the failure sequence detection.
candidate_actions.spec_basis: The specification requires resetting the failure sequence detection after a complete 6-bit group is processed.
